configurePresets.name: linux-clang
configurePresets.description: Clang + Ninja. Set CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH to your Qt kit (e.g. ~/Qt/6.11.2/gcc_64).

configurePresets.name: macos-clang
configurePresets.description: Apple Clang + Ninja. Set CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH to your Qt kit (e.g. ~/Qt/6.11.2/macos). Use the pinned macos-clang-qt611 / macos-clang-qt612 presets to skip the env var. A Homebrew Qt (/opt/homebrew) also works, but the official kits are what CI and the other presets use.

configurePresets.name: macos-clang-qt611
configurePresets.description: Same Apple Clang toolchain as macos-clang, pinned to the stable Qt 6.11.2 kit (~/Qt/6.11.2/macos) with its own build dir. This is the default macOS build. The official 6.11.2 kit ships without Positioning/Location/WebSockets/SerialPort ticked by default -- macdeployqt needs SerialPort too, to bundle the Positioning module's NMEA plugin -- so add all four via the Qt Maintenance Tool if this preset fails to configure or the built app is missing QtSerialPort.framework.

configurePresets.name: macos-clang-qt612
configurePresets.description: Same Apple Clang toolchain as macos-clang, but pinned to the locally installed Qt 6.12 beta kit (~/Qt/6.12.0/macos) with an isolated build dir so beta artifacts never mix with the stable build. For day-to-day work prefer macos-clang-qt611 (stable); use this one to check the app against the beta. The kit path is pinned here; edit it if the beta version changes.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc
configurePresets.description: MSVC 2022 (v143) via the Visual Studio generator. Set CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH to your Qt kit (e.g. D:/Qt/6.11.2/msvc2022_64). Only VS Build Tools is installed here, not the full IDE -- the Visual Studio generator drives Build Tools fine, so no extra setup is needed.

configurePresets.name: windows-llvm
configurePresets.description: Clang + lld + Ninja using Qt's bundled llvm-mingw toolchain. Put the llvm-mingw bin (D:/Qt/Tools/llvm-mingw1706_64/bin) and Ninja (D:/Qt/Tools/Ninja) on PATH -- neither is on PATH by default -- and set CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH to the ABI-matching kit (e.g. D:/Qt/6.11.2/llvm-mingw_64) -- NOT the msvc kit. Use the pinned windows-llvm-qt611 / windows-llvm-qt612 presets to skip the env var. Note 6.11.1 has an llvm-mingw kit but it lacks Positioning/Location/WebSockets; 6.11.2 is the stable kit to use.

configurePresets.name: windows-llvm-qt611
configurePresets.description: Same llvm-mingw toolchain as windows-llvm, pinned to the stable Qt 6.11.2 kit (D:/Qt/6.11.2/llvm-mingw_64) with its own build dir. This is the default Windows build. Needs the llvm-mingw bin (D:/Qt/Tools/llvm-mingw1706_64/bin) and Ninja (D:/Qt/Tools/Ninja) on PATH. 6.11.2, not 6.11.1 -- the 6.11.1 llvm-mingw kit lacks Positioning/Location/WebSockets.

configurePresets.name: windows-llvm-qt612
configurePresets.description: Same llvm-mingw toolchain as windows-llvm, but pinned to the locally installed Qt 6.12 beta kit (D:/Qt/6.12.0/llvm-mingw_64) with an isolated build dir so beta artifacts never mix with the stable build. For day-to-day work prefer windows-llvm-qt611 (stable); use this one to check the app against the beta. Still needs the llvm-mingw bin (D:/Qt/Tools/llvm-mingw1706_64/bin) and Ninja (D:/Qt/Tools/Ninja) on PATH. The kit path is pinned here; edit it if the beta version changes.
